themes.label: New regulatory schemes: sandboxes, co-regulation
themes.definition: Argument that exponential technological change requires new, agile regulatory techniques (sandboxes, co-regulation) to protect people and ensure responsible, equitable use; not specifically international.
themes.inclusion: Include passages proposing specific regulatory methods or new regulatory schemes to keep pace with AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls for international treaties or global bodies (AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: If the regulatory innovation is proposed for global adoption, code both this and AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: require us to create new regulatory schemes to protect people
Those new techniques, such as sandboxes and co-regulation, must have as their ultimate goal the responsible use of emerging technologies

themes.label: Ethical application of AI
themes.definition: Highlighting the ethical application of AI as a standout challenge.
themes.inclusion: Include passages foregrounding ethical use of AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude regulatory-technique discussion without ethical framing.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Equitable application' can overlap with AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE if between-country access is meant.

examples.quote: the question of the ethical application of artificial intelligence and of advances in technology in general stands out here

value.rationale: A single Paraguay 2024 passage links technology to development and highlights ethical AI, proposing agile regulatory techniques to match exponential change.
